- Role: Solo Developer
- Stack: Google Apps Script, Tally, EasySlip API, LINE Messaging API, Google Sheets
- What Tharit did: Built the webhook receiving Tally form submissions, EasySlip slip verification (matchAmount: 50), Sheets logging, LINE flex message notifications (no-fee, slip valid, slip invalid), an onEdit trigger for "ready to pack" notifications, a daily time-based trigger reporting pending cases, and a Print Tracking menu tool rendering 6×4 inch shipping labels.

## n8n-watchlist-tracking | n8n Stock Watchlist: Automated Target Price Tracking
A self-hosted n8n automation that polls Finnhub stock prices, updates a Notion watchlist database, and sends a nightly email summary.
- Role: Solo Developer (2025)
- Stack: n8n, Notion, Finnhub API, Docker, Synology NAS (Container Manager)
- What Tharit did: Built an n8n workflow triggered Mon–Fri at 22:00 that reads tickers and target prices from a Notion database, fetches a real-time quote per ticker via Finnhub, writes prices back to Notion rows (with a formula flagging tickers at/below target), and sends a summary email. n8n runs as a Docker container on a 24/7 Synology NAS.
- Outcome and metrics: Replaces a manual daily price check with an automated nightly digest; self-hosted with no cloud dependency and no running cost beyond existing hardware. Status: published, self-hosted/active.

## tracking-arka | ARKA Tracking: J&T Slip OCR & LINE Customer Self-Query
A Google Apps Script system for a clothing boutique that extracts tracking data from J&T Express slip images via OCR and lets customers self-query shipment status through LINE OA.
- Role: Solo Developer

- What Tharit did: Built, in one day (6–8 hours), a web app where employees upload slip photos; the system saves images to Google Drive, runs OCR text detection, extracts tracking number, customer name, phone, and date via regex, and appends rows to Google Sheets; also built a LINE OA flow where customers send a 10-digit phone number and receive tracking details and a J&T tracking link for orders in the past 7 days.
- Outcome and metrics: Removes manual tracking data entry entirely (previously dozens of orders a day entered by hand, with typos); status Active / Internal Tool. No quantitative metrics stated.
